fields.value: The objective of this project was to modernize the organization's payment infrastructure by replacing multiple legacy payment systems with a centralized Global Payment Hub. The solution enabled seamless processing of domestic and international payments while supporting multiple payment rails such as SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and Fedwire. The project focused on improving payment processing efficiency, reducing operational risk, ensuring regulatory compliance, and enhancing straight-through processing (STP).

fields.value: The objective of this project was to develop a centralized Trade Lifecycle Dashboard to provide end-to-end visibility of trade activities across multiple asset classes. The dashboard enabled Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, and Management teams to monitor trade status from execution through settlement by consolidating trade information from multiple upstream and downstream systems. The solution helped improve operational efficiency by reducing manual monitoring, identifying failed trades, tracking settlement exceptions, monitoring KPIs, and providing real-time trade status across the complete trade lifecycle.
